newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African, UK bourses to share trade information.
newsitem.headline: S.African, UK bourses to share trade information.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE) have agreed to share all regulatory information relating to their members and their share dealings, the JSE said on Monday.
JSE Executive President Roy Andersen said the agreement would help build a more comprehensive picture of trading activity between the two markets and combat market abuse.
"It will enable us to exchange information when we suspect price manipulation, for example," Andersen said.
Johannesburg and London share a large number of dual-listed companies, with 71 South African stocks also listed in Britain.
The two bourses will sign a Memorandum of Understanding at a ceremony at the LSE on Tuesday.
